promise: Donate 1 billion COVID-19 vaccine doses to poorer countries by the end of 2022
description: At the June 2021 G7 summit in Carbis Bay, leaders pledged to share 1 billion COVID-19 vaccine doses with low- and middle-income countries by the end of 2022 (870 million new doses plus earlier pledges), including 500 million from the United States. Delivery fell far short: Oxfam and the People's Vaccine Alliance found that less than half (49%) of the 2.1 billion doses promised globally by G7 countries had been delivered by June 2022, and the UK had delivered only 39% of its 100 million pledge by its own deadline.
